attributes.action: Inquiry into SEND Failures and Whistleblower Allegations in England
attributes.additional_details: I am calling on the UK Government to launch an independent public inquiry into how Local Authorities in England administer SEND support, including whether families are being unfairly denied legal entitlements. This follows an ITV News investigation where a whistleblower SEND caseworker alleged practices making it harder for families to access support, alongside rising EHCP delays and tribunal rulings often favouring families. These concerns suggest possible systemic failings requiring scrutiny.
attributes.background: I am calling for a public inquiry into SEND support across England’s Local Authorities, following an ITV News investigation alleging harmful practices, delays and systemic pressures in one authority. It raises concerns that families may be denied legal support and needs full independent review.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Launch a public inquiry into the SEND system in England" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/776302
